actions.action: Verify Python 3 and the project directory on EC2.

ai_assistant.role: Prepare minimal read-only checks for Python version, working directory, and directory writability; explain the results.
ai_assistant.expected_outcome: Record the Python 3 version, EC2 working directory, and whether that directory is writable, without installing or changing system packages.

human.role: Review this step and approve its scope or request changes; supply EC2 output if direct execution is unavailable.
human.expected_outcome: Explicit approval of this step's revision, with actual execution output supplied when required.

ec2_server.role: Run the approved environment checks and return their outputs.
ec2_server.expected_outcome: Python 3 runs successfully on EC2 and the selected project directory is writable.

verification_checks: Record the Python 3 version and exit status on EC2.
Record the chosen project directory and a writability check.
If any prerequisite fails, stop and record the blocker.

ai_assistant.role: Implement a small standard-library Python entry point with add, list, and complete subcommands and argument validation.
ai_assistant.expected_outcome: The help text and command parsing work; blank titles and invalid integer IDs are rejected; unfinished commands do not falsely report success.

human.role: Review this step and approve its scope or request changes; supply EC2 output if direct execution is unavailable.
human.expected_outcome: Explicit approval of this step's revision, with actual execution output supplied when required.

ec2_server.expected_outcome: Help and parser checks produce the expected messages and exit statuses.

verification_checks: Help lists add, list, and complete.
A whitespace-only title is rejected.
A non-integer or nonpositive task ID is rejected.
Unknown commands fail clearly.

actions.action: Implement JSON storage, adding tasks, and listing tasks.

ai_assistant.role: Implement JSON loading and validation, unique IDs, safe saving, and add/list behavior.
ai_assistant.expected_outcome: Tasks persist across invocations; malformed data is reported without reset or overwrite; failed saves leave existing data intact.

human.role: Review this step and approve its scope or request changes; supply EC2 output if direct execution is unavailable.
human.expected_outcome: Explicit approval of this step's revision, with actual execution output supplied when required.

ec2_server.role: Run add, list, restart, malformed-data, and write-failure checks using isolated test data.
ec2_server.expected_outcome: Storage checks produce observable results without damaging existing task data.

verification_checks: A missing data file lists an empty collection.
Add two tasks and list their IDs, titles, and incomplete status.
Run the program again and verify both tasks remain.
A further task receives a distinct ID after restart.
Malformed JSON and invalid task records fail without overwriting the file.
A simulated save failure preserves the previous data file.

ai_assistant.role: Implement complete TASK_ID and its error handling using the existing storage functions.
ai_assistant.expected_outcome: The selected task becomes complete and stays complete across invocations; other tasks remain unchanged; an unknown ID causes no data changes.

human.role: Review this step and approve its scope or request changes; supply EC2 output if direct execution is unavailable.
human.expected_outcome: Explicit approval of this step's revision, with actual execution output supplied when required.

ec2_server.expected_outcome: Stored state and command results show the required completion behavior.

verification_checks: Complete one existing task and list tasks in a fresh invocation.
Confirm only the selected task changed.
Completing the same task again creates no duplicate and leaves it complete.
An unknown ID fails clearly and leaves stored data unchanged.

actions.action: Verify the complete tracker on EC2 and document usage.

ai_assistant.role: Prepare concise usage instructions and execute or guide a final end-to-end check against the goal.
ai_assistant.expected_outcome: Record EC2 evidence for all goal criteria and provide commands for normal use and the data-file location.

human.role: Review this step and approve its scope or request changes; supply EC2 output if direct execution is unavailable.
human.expected_outcome: Explicit approval of this step's revision, with actual execution output supplied when required.

ec2_server.role: Run the final end-to-end and error checks on EC2 with isolated test data.
ec2_server.expected_outcome: The final application passes the goal criteria on EC2 and its verification evidence is available.

verification_checks: Add two tasks, list them, complete one, and verify persistence in separate invocations.
Verify blank-title, invalid-ID, unknown-ID, malformed-data, and filesystem-error behavior.
Confirm failed operations preserve existing data.
Confirm standard-library-only execution and record the exact commands, outputs, and data path.
